lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice linking what has already happened to a concrete plan for later.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Coordinating a plan after some preparation has already been done.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Making a plan based on current progress.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik plan an evening activity after checking what has already been prepared and what still needs doing.

main_focus.name: perfekt plus future plan
main_focus.description: Combine har plus supine for completed preparation with ska or tänker for the next planned step.
model_examples: Jag har redan handlat, så vi ska laga mat hemma.
Vi har inte bestämt tiden än, men jag tänker fråga i kväll.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use the pattern naturally 3-4 times, linking status to next action.

allowed_supporting_grammar: preteritum for one earlier event if needed

useful_chunks: Vi har inte bestämt tiden än.
Då behöver vi bara ordna en sak.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use preparation verbs and status words that naturally trigger perfekt.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person asks what is already prepared.
dialogue_shape.middle: They connect completed tasks and missing details to a next action.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on the later plan and who will handle the remaining detail.

target_complexity.repetition: make the status-to-plan link clear several times

focus: what preparation has already been done

sentence_focus: one sentence with har redan plus a preparation verb
one sentence with har inte plus än
one sentence explaining that only one thing remains
one sentence linking completed preparation to an easier plan
